ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a cumulative relative frequency/percentile curve, with the horizontal axis as Score and the vertical axis as Percentile. The curve rises very quickly in the lower to middle score range, approximately between 10 and 40 points, and then gradually flattens in the higher score range, approximately near 60 to 90 points, approaching 100%. Reasoning: The places where the slope of the cumulative relative frequency curve is large indicate that the data in that score interval are relatively concentrated, and the places where the slope is small or becomes flat indicate that there are fewer data in that interval. Therefore, most scores are concentrated in the lower to middle scores, while fewer scores extend to the higher-score end, and the tail is on the right side, so the distribution is right-skewed.
